{{Quote|They ransacked the camp for supplies and uniforms--even stole identification off each body. Then they found one of our maps. We'd located a hidden cave at the bottom of the waterfall nearby. They could regroup there and shoot anyone who gets close.|Research Assistant Starforth, to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Into the Maw" />}}
The '''Jurgoran Maw''' was a cave located at the base of a waterfall sinkhole in the [[Riverfall Wilds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] spies infiltrating the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] made their base there, but they were wiped out by Imperial forces.<ref name="Into the Maw" />
